Subject: CAIQ mapping + runtime log samples for control verification

Diego —

Thanks for taking this on. As discussed on the call, MidBank needs a concise control index that maps Redwood's CAIQ answers to our internal control IDs, plus a small sample of runtime logs demonstrating isolation and telemetry for the last 30 days. The audit team needs:

- a one-sheet mapping (your CAIQ ID -> MidBank control ID -> short rationale)
- runtime log samples (token-level telemetry is not required; we need request/response traces with timestamps, model ID, and tenant tag)
- confirmation of where persisted artifacts live and retention policy

If you can provide a draft mapping and an example of the log bundle by EOD Monday 5/17, that would keep our review on schedule. If there are any controls you consider out-of-scope for MidBank's tenant boundary, please flag them with alternatives.

Priya will be our internal reviewer.

Best,
Tom

--

Senior InfoSec Auditor
MidBank Financial

Diego / Tom —

Attached is a first-pass one-page crosswalk (midbank_caiq_scope_matrix.xlsx) and the CSV index (control_index_v1.csv). Notes in the spreadsheet:

- Column A: CAIQ question ID
- Column B: Redwood answer (short)
- Column C: MidBank control ID (our suggested mapping)
- Column D: Owner / evidence pointer (link or artifact name)
- Column E: Scope note (in-scope / out-of-scope + brief rationale)

A few specific flags for the audit team:
- Identity proofing (CCM-1): our managed auth layer is shared across tenants; for MidBank we recommend validating SAML metadata ingestion rather than asking for per-tenant password policies.
- Logging retention: default is 90 days for detailed traces, 365 for aggregated metrics; we can provide a short retention attestation.

I'll iterate on wording if the reviewers want more explicit control language. Diego, Jonas — can you confirm evidence file names you will provide so I can fill the "Owner / evidence pointer" fields?

Kimberly
